# Retained content controls inside drawing text boxes

Original OOXML generated by tools/retained_textbox_controls_fixture.py using
repository-authored drawing helpers. Six cases cross standalone/grouped shapes
with locked block controls, inline date controls and nested block/inline controls.
Saved text, control properties and wrappers are retained; there is no corpus
artwork. The second DOCX contains identical content without the wrappers.

The reference application exported both six-page PDFs. All native pages were
inspected. tools/retained_textbox_controls_reference.py verifies that every
wrapped/unwrapped page raster is RGB-identical and records PDF/source hashes.
The browser also requires exact equality of the drawing crops between the two
files. A two-pixel bidirectional native glyph mask check supplements this through
body edits and reopening. It excludes the body caret; a one-pixel check exposed
two pre-existing hinted glyph pixels also present without wrappers. No renderer
change or document-specific text adjustment was made for those pixels.

ECMA-376 Part 1 sections 17.5.2.29/31 (block/run sdt) and 17.5.2.34/36
(sdtContent) define the saved contents. The drawing remains an atomic retained
object, so a disposable clone may project those contents for layout while its
original XML preserves locks, metadata, nesting and formatting through body
edits. Direct editing of controls inside drawings and refreshing external
bindings are outside this feature. Unsupported projected formatting/blocks still
use the existing strict text-box checks; malformed envelopes remain rejected.

Unit checks exercise text projection, exact no-edit/undo packages, unchanged
drawing XML after body edits, export/reopen and malformed envelope rejection.
The fixture properties and default zoom metadata were corrected to pass the
schemas before the final references and exports were generated.
